=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Medium."
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Odette. Their Archivist report doesn't fit the facts as I know them."
Agnes: "From my window, I saw Hollis leave their house last night."  [case board: #36, #37, #38]
Odette: "I hate sounding like the local gossips, yet something about Merrin rings decidedly hollow."  [case board: #39]
Merrin: "Beware Nisha, good neighbors, before it's too late! My own reading says everyone living on the Market is on the same side, most likely all good, so the evil has to be somewhere else, and they're one of the few left."  [case board: #40]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Martyr."
Nisha: "Last night, I have given my life over for Hollis, should the town ever hang them."
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Agnes about Odette."  [case board: #41, #42, #43]
Edda: "No sense keeping the lid on the pot when the kitchen's smoking. I am the Rumormonger."
Edda: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Merrin and Odette is a Sleepwalker."
Edda: "Odette has the right of it about Merrin, friends."  [case board: #44, #45, #46]
Merrin: "Beware Dorian, good neighbors, before it's too late! My own reading says everyone living on the Market is on the same side, most likely all good, so the evil has to be somewhere else, and they're one of the few left."  [case board: #47]

Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Night Watch."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Market: nobody stirred."
Isolde: "Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Merrin pass by."  [case board: #51, #52, #53]
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it longer. I am the Lamplighter."
